content.title: Careers
content.summary: Majestic View Nature Center is seeking passionate individuals to join their team as environmental educators and camp staff, focusing on connecting the community with nature through various programs. Available positions include a year-round part-time Environmental Educator, a seasonal Environmental Educator, a Summer Camp Educator for children ages 7-11, and a Camp Administrator to support program development and staff mentoring. Each role emphasizes education, engagement, and fostering a love for the natural world.
content.body:
## Join Our Team at Majestic View Nature Center!

Do you have a passion for nature, education, and inspiring the next generation of environmental stewards? At Majestic View Nature Center, we're dedicated to fostering curiosity, connection, and care for the natural world through innovative programming, community engagement, and immersive outdoor experiences.

We're looking for enthusiastic, nature-loving individuals to join our team! Whether you're leading a summer camp group through a hiking trail or crafting engaging programs for local schools, each role plays a key part in our mission to connect people with nature in meaningful ways.

### Positions Offered

**Year-round Part-time Environmental Educator**   
Bring nature to life for learners of all ages! Create and teach engaging environmental programs for schools and the public, lead interpretive experiences on Arvada’s trails, and support the day-to-day operations of Majestic View with a focus on customer connection and environmental awareness. This position will work an average of 29 hours/week, year-round.

**Seasonal Environmental Educator** ([Now Hiring! Apply Here.](https://arvada.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/City_of_Arvada_External_Career_Site/details/Environmental-Education-Specialist---Seasonal_2025-0283-1))  
Bring nature to life for learners of all ages! Create and teach engaging environmental programs for schools and the public, lead interpretive experiences on Arvada’s trails, and support the day-to-day operations of Majestic View with a focus on customer connection and environmental awareness. This position will be full-time during the season, March through October.

**Summer Camp Educator**([Now Hiring! Apply Here.](https://arvada.wd5.myworkdayjobs.com/en-US/City_of_Arvada_External_Career_Site/details/Summer-Camp-Instructor---Majestic-View-Nature-Center_2025-0276))  
Inspire young minds through hands-on nature exploration! Lead classroom and outdoor camp experiences for children ages 7-11, delivering engaging curriculum while maintaining a safe and fun learning environment. This role supports our licensed child care operations and requires strong leadership, communication, and teaching skills.

**Camp Administrator**  
Help shape the magic of camp! Support our Nature Center Director and Assistant Director in developing summer camp programs that spark wonder and excitement for nature. This is a creative role that includes mentoring camp staff, outdoor teaching, safety oversight, and team collaboration in a dynamic, nature-based setting.
